feeds.title: Minimal Beauty Blog
feeds.description: Minimal Beauty Blog is a cool, calm and collected approach to beauty, Ayurveda, and lifestyle. Hi! I'm Jen. As the founder of Minimal Beauty, I'm inspired by the power of holistic remedies that nourish skin from the inside out. My zone of genius is in assisting women in getting grounded into their skincare and self-care rituals, making time for themselves to deeply connect with their skin, innate radiance, and overall break free from the societal conditioning around beauty.

feeds.title: The Beauty Minimalist
feeds.description: The Beauty Minimalist is an everyday makeup and skincare blog by Kara Ferguson.

feeds.title: The Luxe Minimalist » Beauty
feeds.description: Beauty reviews for luxury beauty lovers on a budget. Find out what's worth the splurge and discover dupes of popular luxury makeup & skincare products. The Luxe Minimalist has evolved into the go-to destination for those looking to live a luxurious lifestyle on their own terms.

feeds.title: Mademoiselle » Beauty
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Jamie-Lee. This section of Mademoiselle provides minimalistic makeup, skincare, hair, fragrance, body, and more beauty guidance articles.

feeds.title: Style & Minimalism » Beauty & Wellbeing
feeds.description: Style&Minimalism is a platform that inspires a more conscious lifestyle. The articles shared on Style&Minimalism are aimed at helping people make better, more educated decisions about how they spend their money and how they impact our planet. All articles are written by Vikki Pearson, a writer and photographer.

feeds.title: SaltyGirl Beauty Blog
feeds.description: We're talking about everything from skincare, to the community, stories behind beauty, incorporating self-care, and much more over on the SaltyGirl blog. Sassy sisters Sarah, a breast cancer survivor and Leah, an oncology nurse, set out to create a beauty brand that nourished and empowered women in their community.
